arxiv-1909-07816.title: The Computational Complexity of Fire Emblem Series and similar Tactical Role-Playing Games
arxiv-1909-07816.creator: Jiawei Gao
arxiv-1909-07816.description: A 2019 arXiv research paper by Jiawei Gao. Fire Emblem (FE) is a popular turn-based tactical role-playing game (TRPG) series on the Nintendo gaming consoles. This paper studies the computational complexity of a simplified version of FE (only floor tiles and wall tiles, the HP and other attributes of characters are constants at most 8 8 , the movement distance per character each turn is fixed to 6 6 tiles), and proves that: 1. Simplified FE is PSPACE-complete (Thus actual FE is at least as hard).

arxiv-2011-04717.title: Real-time Locational Marginal Price Forecasting Using Generative Adversarial Network PubID: pubid: 978-1-7281-6127-3/20/$31.00 ©2020 IEEE
arxiv-2011-04717.creator: Zhongxia Zhang, Meng Wu
arxiv-2011-04717.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Zhongxia Zhang, Meng Wu. In this paper, we propose a model-free unsupervised learning approach to forecast real-time locational marginal prices (RTLMPs) in wholesale electricity markets. By organizing system-wide hourly RTLMP data into a 3-dimensional (3D) tensor consisting of a series of time-indexed matrices, we formulate the RTLMP forecasting problem as a problem of generating the next matrix with forecasted RTLMPs given the historical RTLMP tensor, and propose a generative adversarial network (GAN) model to forecast RTLMPs.

arxiv-2102-03274.title: On the Sample Complexity of Causal Discovery and the Value of Domain Expertise
arxiv-2102-03274.creator: Samir Wadhwa, Roy Dong
arxiv-2102-03274.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Samir Wadhwa, Roy Dong. Causal discovery methods seek to identify causal relations between random variables from purely observational data, as opposed to actively collected experimental data where an experimenter intervenes on a subset of correlates. One of the seminal works in this area is the Inferred Causation algorithm, which guarantees successful causal discovery under the assumption of a conditional independence (CI) oracle: an oracle that can states whether two random variables are conditionally independent given another set of random variables.

arxiv-2102-05526.title: Dynamic β \beta -VAEs for quantifying biodiversity by clustering optically recorded insect signals Journal: Ecological Informatics
arxiv-2102-05526.creator: Klas Rydhmer, Raghavendra Selvan
arxiv-2102-05526.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Klas Rydhmer, Raghavendra Selvan. While insects are the largest and most diverse group of terrestrial animals, constituting ca. 80 80 % of all known species, they are difficult to study due to their small size and similarity between species. Conventional monitoring techniques depend on time consuming trapping methods and tedious microscope-based work by skilled experts in order to identify the caught insect specimen at species, or even family level.

arxiv-2104-15042.title: Divide-and-conquer based Large-Scale Spectral Clustering
arxiv-2104-15042.creator: Hongmin Li, Xiucai Ye, Akira Imakura, Tetsuya Sakurai
arxiv-2104-15042.description: Abstract Spectral clustering is one of the most popular clustering methods. However, how to balance the efficiency and effectiveness of the large-scale spectral clustering with limited computing resources has not been properly solved for a long time. In this paper, we propose a divide-and-conquer based large-scale spectral clustering method to strike a good balance between efficiency and effectiveness.

arxiv-2105-04117.title: Wiki-Reliability: A Large Scale Dataset for Content Reliability on Wikipedia Conference: Proceedings of the 44th International ACM SIGIR Conference on Research and Development in Information Retrieval; July 11–15, 2021; Virtual Event, Canada Proceedings of the 44th International ACM SIGIR Conference
arxiv-2105-04117.creator: KayYen Wong, Miriam Redi, Diego Saez-Trumper
arxiv-2105-04117.description: Abstract . Wikipedia is the largest online encyclopedia, used by algorithms and web users as a central hub of reliable information on the web. The quality and reliability of Wikipedia content is maintained by a community of volunteer editors. Machine learning and information retrieval algorithms could help scale up editors’ manual efforts around Wikipedia content reliability.

arxiv-2211-01734.title: Tunable Chiral Bound States in a Dimer Chain of Coupled Resonators
arxiv-2211-01734.creator: Jing Li, Jing Lu, Z. R. Gong, Lan Zhou
arxiv-2211-01734.description: Abstract We study an excitation hopping on a one-dimensional (1D) dimer chain of coupled resonators with the alternate on-site photon energies, which interacts with a two-level emitter (TLE) by a coupling point or two adjacent coupling points. In the single-excitation subspace, this system not only possesses two energy bands with propagating states, but also possesses photonic bound states.

arxiv-2305-03213.title: Toric supervarieties with one odd dimension
arxiv-2305-03213.creator: Eric Jankowski
arxiv-2305-03213.description: Abstract . In this paper we describe the notion of a toric supervariety, generalizing that of a toric variety from the classical setting. We give a combinatorial interpretation of the category of quasinormal toric supervarieties with one odd dimension using decorated polyhedral fans.

arxiv-2310-14884.title: Budgeted Embedding Table For Recommender Systems Conference: Proceedings of the 17th ACM International Conference on Web Search and Data Mining; March 4–8, 2024; Merida, Mexico Proceedings of the 17th ACM International Conference on Web Search and Data Mining (WSDM ’24), March 4–8, 2024, Merida, Mex
arxiv-2310-14884.creator: Yunke Qu, Tong Chen, Quoc Viet Hung Nguyen, Hongzhi Yin
arxiv-2310-14884.description: Abstract . At the heart of contemporary recommender systems (RSs) are latent factor models that provide quality recommendation experience to users. These models use embedding vectors, which are typically of a uniform and fixed size, to represent users and items. As the number of users and items continues to grow, this design becomes inefficient and hard to scale.

arxiv-2406-03341.title: Tackling Copyright Issues in AI Image Generation Through Originality Estimation and Genericization
arxiv-2406-03341.creator: Hiroaki Chiba-Okabe, Weijie J. Su
arxiv-2406-03341.description: Abstract The rapid progress of generative AI technology has sparked significant copyright concerns, leading to numerous lawsuits filed against AI developers. Notably, generative AI’s capacity for generating images of copyrighted characters has been well documented in the literature, and while various techniques for mitigating copyright issues have been studied, significant risks remain.

arxiv-2410-14339.title: Convergence of the Dirichlet–Neumann method for semilinear elliptic equations Thanks: Version of August 24, 2026.
arxiv-2410-14339.creator: Emil Engström
arxiv-2410-14339.description: Abstract The Dirichlet–Neumann method is a common domain decomposition method for nonoverlapping domain decomposition and the method has been studied extensively for linear elliptic equations. However, for nonlinear elliptic equations, there are only convergence results for some specific cases in one spatial dimension.

arxiv-2505-01433.title: LANTERN: TCR-Peptide Binding Prediction via Large Language Model Representations
arxiv-2505-01433.creator: Cong Qi, Hanzhang Fan, Siqi Jiang, Tianxing Hu, Wei Zhi
arxiv-2505-01433.description: Abstract Predicting T-cell receptor (TCR) and peptide-major histocompatibility complex (pMHC) interactions is vital for advancing targeted immunotherapies and personalized medicine. However, existing models face challenges due to limited data and the constant emergence of novel epitopes, constraining their predictive accuracy.

Studies have shown that diet-induced metabolic dysfunctions can be transmitted to multiple generations of offspring and exert long-lasting health burden.

pmc-11689636.title: AGEISM EVERYWHERE ALL AT ONCE: DIFFERENT MANIFESTATIONS AND RESEARCH APPROACHES
pmc-11689636.creator: Alison Chasteen
pmc-11689636.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). In the over 50 years since ageism was defined, the impact of age prejudice has never been clearer, with the increased expression of age bias both during and after the COVID-19 pandemic. This symposium aims to highlight the pervasive nature of ageism through a range of methodological approaches, including in-depth interviews, social media scraping, and experimental surveys, to underscore the ubiquity of ageism in contemporary society.

pmc-12420834.title: A long noncoding RNA-based serum signature predicts ado-trastuzumab emtansine (T-DM1) treatment benefit in HER2+ metastatic breast cancer patients: a multicenter cohort study
pmc-12420834.creator: Syed S Islam, Taher Al-Tweigeri, Asma Tulbah, Saleh N Najjar, Sarah S Aljohani, Layla Al-Harbi, Ahmed M Gad, Shafat Ujjahan, Abdelilah Aboussekhra
pmc-12420834.description: Ado-trastuzumab is considered a standard treatment for patients with HER2+ metastatic breast cancer (mBC). Current clinical practices do not reliably predict therapeutic outcomes for patients who are refractory to therapy. Long noncoding RNAs (lncRNAs) are emerging as critical regulators of gene expression and therapeutic resistance, and the use of lncRNAs as tumor biomarkers is becoming more common in other diseases.

pmc-12555697.title: COVID-19 vaccination and institutional communication: Lessons learned
pmc-12555697.creator: J Sanchez
pmc-12555697.description: BackgroundMinority populations have higher COVID-19 incidence, mortality, and hospitalization rates compared to White populations. COVID-19 vaccination and booster rates remain lower than White populations despite offering significant protection. Effective and culturally appropriate communication is critical for these racial and ethnic populations to make informed decisions about COVID-19 vaccination and associated boosters.

pmc-12786808.description: Background: Despite the advantages of extraperitoneal cesarean delivery (EPCD) indicated by observational studies, there is little accurate evidence supporting this technique, and the studies performed have included small numbers of participants. We aimed to examine intra- and postoperative maternal and neonatal outcomes in EPCD compared with transperitoneal CD (TPCD).

pmc-13523495.creator: Hsi-Chun Chao, Marisa Asadian, Stanislav S. Rubakhin, Fan Lam, Jonathan V. Sweedler
pmc-13523495.description: Glycolipids are essential for myelin integrity, but their extensive isomeric complexity, where isomers like galactosylceramide (GalCer) and glucosylceramide (GlcCer) have unique functions, has hindered our ability to map their metabolism in the brain.
